This is an application for correction of
the cause title portion of the judgm ent dated
11.10.2022.
It appears that inadvertently the
typographical error has been comm itted, and
instead of 'Vineet Gupta & another' the
respondent has been described as 'State of
Uttarakhand'.
Hence, application is allowed. The
necessary correction be m ade by deleting
'State of Uttarakhand' from the cause title of
the judgm ent dated 11.10.2022 and in its
place 'Vineet Gupta & another' be substituted.
Office to carry out necessary correction.
